start: There is infection in the Clan.
discovered: The Clan has come across a bizarre illness. The Clan will keep an eye on it.
cure_found: A cure to the disease has been discovered! It consists of a mixture of herb1, herb2, herb3 and herb4.
partial_cure: Even if it's not a full cure, it seems that some herbs are able to temporarily reverse the infection's progression.
herb_death: The infection has begun killing off herbs in the territory at an alarming rate.
prey_death: Prey has started being affected by the infection. Hunting patrols avoid the sick prey and come home with less food each day.
inherited_infection: The infection can be passed down from parent to pup.
inherited_immunity: A pup with an immune parent may be born immune to the infection!
lore_spread_by_bite: One becomes infected when bitten by an infected creature.
lore_no_reinfection: Slugcats who have been infected and cured are unable to become infected again.
lore_undead: When a slugcat dies of the infection, the disease continues to control their body.
lore_premature_death: An infected slugcat who is killed before the infection reaches maturity will not come back.
lore_fungal_1: The disease appears to be fungal in nature.
lore_fungal_2: Iterators may have found a cure.
lore_fungal_3: Slugcats who recieve help from Iterators become immune to the infection.
lore_void_1: The infection seems to be Voidish in origin.
lore_void_2: Victims are very prone to violence. Proceed with caution.
lore_void_3: Upon death, the victim appears to become an echo.
lore_void_4: Some local Iterators have abruptly ceased functioning.
lore_parasitic_1: The infection seems to be caused by some sort of rot.
lore_parasitic_2: While the body slowly dies, the brain stays active.
lore_parasitic_4: Iterators have been seen dumping mass amounts of rotted material.
zombie: When a very infected slugcat dies, the disease takes over their body.
